info.title: Knowledge layer API
info.description: The graph as a hosted service: files in, projects edited through change requests a person approves, and a run protocol any agent can work through. Guide: docs/api-guide.html. MCP: the same agent operations at /mcp.

get.description: Whether the service is up, and its version.

post.description: The operator's root key only.

get.description: The caller's workspace and its settings.

patch.description: Admins: self_approval, review_extractions, near_duplicates, max_concurrent_runs, max_storage_bytes.

get.description: The caller: kind (user, service, run, root), role, scopes, workspace.
People in the workspace and their roles.

post.description: Admins. The person signs in with the OIDC issuer, matched by email the first time.
Admins. Returns its key once. Never review:approve.
A person's own key, with their role's scopes or fewer. Shown once.

delete.description: Admins. The key stops working at once.

post.description: Text or base64 bytes. Deduplicated, extracted (or awaiting your extraction), checked against its text, and in the graph when its job is done. Transcripts and requests open a change request.

get.description: Documents, by collection or kind, with their current version.

post.description: The same as POST /v1/sources, as a multipart upload.
One answer per file; one failing does not stop the others.

put.description: Send a folder's full listing: the answer says what to upload, and what is gone (retracted with retract_missing).

get.description: Its versions, what deduplication decided, other places it was seen, its facts.

delete.description: Soft: its facts leave the graph; restore brings them back.

get.description: The current version's text, as stored and quoted.

post.description: Nodes, edges and aliases for a document awaiting one. Checked like any other.
Its current version is back in the graph, if the graph still builds.

get.description: An ingestion or extraction: stage, status, problems, result.
Approved state. Filters: status, owner, due_before, due_after, q. include=pending adds open change requests.

post.description: Opens a change request (202). approve=true: a person who may approve applies it at once (200).

get.description: The record and its summary; the ETag is its version. include=events,plans,pending.

patch.description: Title, description, status, owner, requested_by, due. Send If-Match. Opens a change request; a move the rules forbid is refused (422).

delete.description: Soft, through a change request: it leaves recall, search and the list.

post.description: Through a change request.
Through a change request.
Any change-set operations, in one change request. dry_run=true returns the diff and problems and opens nothing.

get.description: Every applied change: what, when, who proposed and approved it, and the source it quotes.
The review queue: by state (open, applied, rejected, stale), project, proposer.
Its operations, diff, problems, and every decision on it.

patch.description: Its proposer or an approver; checked again. Brings a stale request up to date.

post.description: People only. All operations, some (ops), or edited values (edits). Checked again against what changed since; a request that no longer applies becomes stale (409).
People only, with a note.
For one deliverable: general (tasks as JSON) or openspec (a change folder's files). Opens a change request; approval is the go-ahead.

get.description: By project and state.
Its tasks, checks, and the OpenSpec change it came from.

post.description: An approved plan. Tasks with nothing to wait on are ready.

get.description: Each task's state (and whether a proposed plan change holds it), and every run.

post.description: Its active runs are cancelled.
To a runner offering what the task needs. Returns the run id, a run token, and the env to inject into the machine.
The task goes back to ready.

get.description: State, lease, events, artifacts, questions, outcome.
The task, its checks, upstream outputs, project, requirements, and context. Fetching it renews the lease: the agent has started.

post.description: Orchestrator: provisioning, heartbeat, log. Agent: started, heartbeat, log, progress. Each renews the lease.
A file, pull request, test report, text or link.

get.description: Its bytes.

post.description: The run waits (its lease is paused) until a person answers.

get.description: Agents' questions, open ones by default.
And its answer, once given.

post.description: People only. The run carries on.
A change request with the run as proposer; a person decides.
Outputs, check results, evidence. Checks decide the task; a task marked for a person waits for one. Idempotent with idempotency_key.
The task goes back to ready while retries remain.
What the hook injects, as text and JSON, with each claim's content id and source. as_of, project, budget_tokens, session_id.

get.description: Entities by words: people, roles, policies, projects, code, requirements.
Every claim with its sources, every link; for code, where it is; for a requirement, the tests that verify it.
A fact by content id, with every source that states it.
Everything that depends on a symbol and that it depends on, each call site, and the requirements its tests verify.
In order, after a cursor. wait long-polls.

parameters.name: wait

schema.description: seconds to wait for new events (long poll)
schema.title: Wait

parameters.description: seconds to wait for new events (long poll)

get.description: Server-sent events from a cursor; max_events closes it.

parameters.name: max_events

schema.description: close the stream after this many
schema.title: Max Events

parameters.description: close the stream after this many

post.description: Signed deliveries (KL-Signature), in order, retried until 2xx. The secret is shown once.

get.description: And how far each has delivered.

ops.title: Ops
ops.description: Which operations (1-based); all when left out

ops.title: Ops
ops.description: Operations: projects/model.py's (create_project, set_status, set_field, add_dependency, add_deliverable, set_deliverable, set_step, add_question, close_question, add_decision, delete_project, restore_project), or activate_version, retract_source

question.title: Question
examples: A customer wants an £800 refund in March. Who signs it off?

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Quotes already given in this session are not repeated

files.title: Files
files.description: openspec: {path in the change folder: text}

type.title: Type
type.description: orchestrator: provisioning | heartbeat | log; agent: started | heartbeat | log | progress

name.title: Name
name.description: File name, e.g. refund-policy.md; with the collection, what identifies the document when there is no external_id

content_base64.title: Content Base64
content_base64.description: Or its bytes, base64 (zips for code and openspec)

collection.title: Collection
collection.description: A folder, drive or connector the file belongs to

external_id.title: External Id
external_id.description: The file's id in the system it came from

extraction.title: Extraction
extraction.description: Your own extraction (nodes, edges, aliases); checked like any other

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: For a transcript or request: the change-set operations it supports, each quoting it; opened as a change request

needs.title: Needs
needs.description: What a runner must offer, e.g. repo:acme/shop, browser, python

gate.title: Gate
gate.description: A person looks before the task counts as done

tags.name: workspaces
tags.description: Workspaces, members, service accounts and keys.

tags.name: sources
tags.description: Files in: any set of files, deduplicated, extracted, checked. For input handlers.

tags.name: projects
tags.description: Projects, read as approved; every write opens a change request. For task apps.

tags.name: review
tags.description: Change requests: approve (all, some, or edited) or reject. Only people approve.

tags.name: plans
tags.description: A deliverable's plan: a graph of tasks, general or imported from an OpenSpec change.

tags.name: execution
tags.description: The orchestrator's side of the run protocol: executions and leases.

tags.name: runs
tags.description: The agent's side of the run protocol: brief, events, artifacts, questions, complete.

tags.name: context
tags.description: Reading the graph: context for a question, search, entities, code impact.

tags.name: events
tags.description: Every change, once, in order: a cursor feed, a stream, and signed webhooks.
